meta.title: Overdue theme
meta.description: Recolors the Web UI with the Overdue palette: cream with ink-black primary buttons and a soft purple accent in light mode, warm charcoal with an amber accent in dark mode. It is a token layer, not a theme entry, so Settings → Appearance gains no extra row: pick Light, Dark, or System there and the palette follows. Switch it off in Settings → Plugins. No network access, no settings, no stored data; tokens that later DSH releases add stay unthemed.
